human_tolerance.notes: Uses rank grass, reeds, parks and farmland, often near water.

phases.name: breeding
phases.note: ADW describes September through January breeding in winter-rainfall areas such as southern Africa; South Africa also contains summer-rainfall regions, so this national calendar is an approximation.

vocalizations.description: Simple, harsh nasal song that descends on the final note.
Short contact and alarm calls; simplified simulation cue.

taxonomy.note: GBIF resolves accepted species Estrilda astrild (Linnaeus, 1758), rank SPECIES; iNaturalist taxon 13770 independently returns active species Estrilda astrild.

external.note: GBIF key and iNaturalist taxon checked at their own providers on 2026-10-31; iNaturalist API response confirms active species rank.

range.note: Native range abstracted as sub-Saharan Africa; ZA is within the native range. Do not use introduced extra-African records as native range.

traits.locomotion_modes.note: Article describes feeding by clinging to stems and searching for fallen seeds on the ground; Hop and Fly are simulation locomotion mappings.

traits.nest_type.note: Article describes a woven grass ball built low among dense vegetation; Ground is the closest schema nest-type mapping.

traits.size_class.note: Tiny based on 8.9 g reported mass.

traits.mass_kg.note: AVONET Supplementary dataset 1, worksheet AVONET1_BirdLife, Estrilda astrild (Sequence 9790), Mass column 8.29 g, sample size 13; converted to 0.00829 kg.

traits.lifespan_y.note: Lifespan/Longevity section explicitly states average 4 years in the wild; used as typical wild lifespan, not a maximum or captive age. The verified permissive alternatives checked (Wikipedia and the atlas article) did not report this statistic.

traits.diet.note: Mainly grass/millet seeds with occasional insects; 0.9 seed and 0.1 invertebrate are authored allocations because the source has no percentages.

traits.social.note: Article states foraging flocks may contain hundreds or even thousands; the broad interval models that flocking scale and is not a measured distribution.

traits.activity_pattern.note: ADW Behavior section says the flock forages during the day and identifies the species as diurnal.

traits.defense.note: Judgement: flight is the escape response represented.

traits.wariness.note: Judgement for a small flocking bird.

habitat.use.note: AVONET classifies habitat as grassland and primary lifestyle as generalist; Wikipedia describes seed feeding while clinging to grass stems and ground-foraging. Ground/arboreal proportions are authored.

habitat.shelter_tag.note: Dense grasses/reeds and low nest sites mapped to shelter.

habitat.resources.note: Seeds and occasional insects are foods; woven grass nests, perches and regular drinking are source-described. Resource weights are authored.

habitat.human_tolerance.note: ADW reports use of parks, farmland and urban/suburban habitats; tolerance values are authored.

seasonal.strategy.note: The filtered ZA curves have records in all 12 months, supporting year-round activity/presence but not proving that the same birds remain year-round.

seasonal.phases.note: ADW describes September–January breeding in winter-rainfall areas such as southern Africa. South Africa includes other rainfall zones with different breeding timing, so this national profile is an approximation and cannot encode the regional calendar differences.

seasonal.life_stages.note: Juvenile duration 19 days is midpoint of ADW fledging age 17–21 days; scale authored.

behavior.note: Local perching-songbird program uses the article-supported seed food tag, hop feeding, day activity, night resting and flight escape. Its nest action is enabled in months 9,10,11,12,1 from ADW winter-rainfall guidance; this is an approximation at whole-country ZA scope.

vocalizations.song.note: Wikipedia Description section describes a simple harsh nasal song that descends on the last note.

vocalizations.alarm.note: Call is a simplified authored cue; no acoustic transcription encoded.

look.note: Stylized grey-brown body, red conical bill/face patch and red belly; geometry and palette mapping are authored.

traits.length_m.note: Midpoint of the stated adult length range 9.5–13 cm, converted to 0.1125 m and used as a representative simulation value; not a measured mean.
